title: The Tithe of Teeth
text: Under the cathedral, behind a door of rib-bones, something is owed a tithe. This Year it has written down what it wants, which is teeth, a great many of them. The letter is addressed to the richest House in the city.

options.label: Pay it in gold teeth, hoping it is not particular.

outcomes.text: You melt down a strongbox and cast a jawful of golden teeth. The door of rib-bones closes a little, satisfied.

options.label: Pay it in real teeth, as it asked.

outcomes.text: Two of your recruits go down the steps with a pair of pliers and come back up with closed mouths. The thing below is very pleased, and it sends gifts.

options.label: Refuse, and brick up the door of ribs; the city owes it nothing.

outcomes.text: The bricks hold. In the morning every House in the city finds its children's milk teeth gone from their keepsake boxes.
